title: Checking a setup with ros2 doctor
keywords: doctor ros2doctor report check setup network platform
text: ros2 doctor checks the ROS 2 setup (platform, network, environment, middleware and running topics) and prints warnings; ros2 doctor --report prints the full configuration, including the RMW in use and the network interfaces. It is a quick first check on a new machine, but it does not tell whether two specific endpoints can communicate.
